observation.finality: NONE — anvil fork. This is the observation point, not finalized evidence. A public installation must state a finalized block/hash.
observation.scope: FORK REHEARSAL. Not the public installation, not the P04 automated service.

safe.note: An unrecognised enabled module is an unrecognised delegated path and blocks protected activation (V4 §6).

roles.note: A refilling allowance is refused by the controller at activation AND during operation. Read back here rather than trusted from the setup script.

morpho_grants.note: Confirmed by mapping readback, not by history alone. BOUNDARY: this checks the identities listed above. It does not and cannot enumerate every address that might hold a grant, so completeness is within the declared discovery set.

token_approvals.note: The managed Safe->Morpho allowance must be zero at rest; the controller also requires it zero on entry and exit of every operation.

attested_not_verified.statement: Control of the runner and executor keys, and of any KeeperHub organisation credential, is ATTESTED and NOT verified here.
attested_not_verified.why: Public chain data cannot prove private-key ownership. V4 §6 requires this distinction to be explicit rather than folded into the chain findings.
attested_not_verified.fork_note: Every key in this fixture is a well-known anvil account. It is not custody and proves nothing about a production installation.

verdict.important: 'PERMITTED BY THIS CHECKLIST' means the declared sections read clean at this observation point on a FORK. It is not authorization, not finality, and not evidence about the public installation.

non_vacuity_control.why: A checklist that cannot fail is decoration. This records that it does fail, with the exact injected state.
non_vacuity_control.method: On the same fork, impersonated the Safe and injected two supported-profile violations: Morpho.setAuthorization(0x…dEaD, true) and USDC.approve(Morpho, 1).
non_vacuity_control.reading: The two sections that should notice did, the two that should not were unaffected, and the run exited non-zero. V4 §6: incomplete evidence blocks activation.
